label: Bible Study
prompt: Now when Solomon had made an end of praying, the _____ came down from heaven, and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of the LORD filled the house.
verse: Now when Solomon had made an end of praying, the fire came down from heaven, and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of the LORD filled the house.
note: Solomon's dedication prayer gets answered in fire — and the glory so fills the house the priests can't enter.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be _____ with my goodness, saith the LORD.
verse: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, saith the LORD.
note: God promises His people will be satisfied with His goodness — a full table after the exile.

label: Sunday School
prompt: To be taxed with Mary his _____ wife, being great with child.
verse: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.
note: 'Espoused' means engaged — Mary and Joseph made the long trip to Bethlehem as a betrothed couple.

label: Deep Water
prompt: We hanged our _____ upon the willows in the midst thereof.
verse: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.
note: The captors asked for songs of Zion; the exiles hung up their instruments instead.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our _____; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.
verse: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.
note: Our high priest isn't distant: he is 'touched with the feeling of our infirmities' — tempted in all points, yet without sin.
